text: Generally fine, but two conditions. Bedtime: page-turn hooks are an engagement device; in bedtime mode they work against wind-down and must not appear in the last third, and never on the final page. Series: hooks must stay inside the story; no cross-story or episode-end cliffhangers ('come back tomorrow to find out'), which CLAUDE.md calm UX rules out and FAZ 13 already forbids at episode ends. Questions must be about story, not suspense about danger ('But where is Mud?' fine; 'But what was in the dark?' not).
